questions.question: Diff review of the workspace-transcribing change found one worthwhile improvement (full rationale in diff-review-report.md). Which improvements should I apply?

options.label: Align voice-error copy (#4)
options.description: Change "Couldn't catch that — tap to retry" to match the Chat reference wording/casing: "couldn't catch that — tap to retry or type it instead". Recommended for true parity.

options.label: Match dots to Chat footer (#3)
options.description: Change the dot cluster from gap-1/size-1.5 to the Chat footer's gap-0.5/size-1. Note: current code intentionally matches the banner's own ben-typing dots.

options.label: Move pendingDiff guard on top (#5)
options.description: Suppress the transcribing/error banner while a diff is pending. Note: verified the composer stays active during pendingDiff, so the feedback is arguably correct as-is.

options.label: Apply none
options.description: Keep the implementation exactly as it is now; skip all suggested tweaks.
